name: What is the difference between a single-handle and a double-handle bathroom faucet?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a single-handle and a double-handle bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between single-handle and double-handle bathroom faucets lies in their operation and appearance. A single-handle faucet uses one lever or knob to control both water temperature and flow, offering convenience and a minimalist look. A double-handle faucet features separate handles for hot and cold water, allowing for more precise temperature adjustment and often contributing to a more traditional or classic aesthetic. Both types are widely available and their choice often comes down to personal preference, existing sink holes, and design consistency with other bathroom fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Single-handle faucets use one lever for temperature and flow, while double-handle faucets have separate controls for hot and cold water, offering different aesthetics and control.
